# Audio effects

Effects sit in a chain on an [audio bus](Audio-Buses) and work on everything that plays on it, in the order they were added. They keep running after the last sound on the bus has stopped, so echoes and reverb tails ring out. A channel can have a chain of its own as well, for one sound, which ends with the sound. Types and parameters are numbered constants from the shipped include file audio.bb.

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
world = CreateAudioBus()
cave  = AddAudioEffect(world, BB_EFFECT_REVERB)
AudioEffectParam cave, BB_EFFECTPARAM_SIZE, 0.8
AudioEffectParam cave, BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX, 0.5

; Walking out of the cave: the reverb fades out over a second.
AudioEffectParam cave, BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX, 0, 1000
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect), [FreeAudioEffect](FreeAudioEffect) | Add an effect to a bus, and take it off again. |
| [AddChannelEffect](AddChannelEffect) | Add an effect to one channel. |
| [ChannelSend](ChannelSend), [GetChannelSend](GetChannelSend) | Send a channel to a second bus too, such as a shared reverb. |
| [ListenerAirAbsorption](ListenerAirAbsorption) | Distant sounds lose their high frequencies. |
| [AudioEffectParam](AudioEffectParam), [GetAudioEffectParam](GetAudioEffectParam) | A parameter, set at once or over a fade time. |
| [AudioEffectBypass](AudioEffectBypass) | Turns it off and on without losing its settings. |
| [AudioSceneParam](AudioSceneParam), [AudioSceneBypass](AudioSceneBypass) | The same in an [audio scene](Audio-Scenes). |

## Types

Every effect also has `BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX`, how much of what it makes is heard: `0` only the sound, `1` (the default) only the effect. For the echo and the reverb, the repeats come on top of the sound: `0.5` is the sound and the repeats at full level, and `1` only the repeats, for a bus that only holds a reverb.

| Type | Parameters (default) |
| --- | --- |
| `BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS` | `FREQUENCY` (20000), `RESONANCE` (0.707) |
| `BB_EFFECT_HIGHPASS` | `FREQUENCY` (20), `RESONANCE` (0.707) |
| `BB_EFFECT_BANDPASS` | `FREQUENCY` (1000), `RESONANCE` (1) |
| `BB_EFFECT_PEAK` | `FREQUENCY` (1000), `RESONANCE` (1), `GAIN` (0) |
| `BB_EFFECT_LOWSHELF` | `FREQUENCY` (200), `GAIN` (0) |
| `BB_EFFECT_HIGHSHELF` | `FREQUENCY` (4000), `GAIN` (0) |
| `BB_EFFECT_ECHO` | `DELAY` (0.3), `FEEDBACK` (0.4), `DAMPING` (0.3, makes each repeat darker), `MIX` (0.5) |
| `BB_EFFECT_REVERB` | `SIZE` (0.5), `DAMPING` (0.5), `WIDTH` (1), `PREDELAY` (0), `MIX` (0.3) |
| `BB_EFFECT_COMPRESSOR` | `THRESHOLD` (-12), `RATIO` (4), `ATTACK` (0.01), `RELEASE` (0.2), `GAIN` (0, added after) |
| `BB_EFFECT_LIMITER` | `CEILING` (-0.3), `RELEASE` (0.05) |
| `BB_EFFECT_DISTORTION` | `DRIVE` (0.5), `MIX` (1) |
| `BB_EFFECT_LOFI` | `RATE` (8000), `BITS` (8) |

## Parameters

The names are `BB_EFFECTPARAM_` and the name in the table. A value outside the range is a runtime error.

| Parameter | Unit | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MIX` | | 0 to 1 |
| `FREQUENCY` | Hz | 1 to 100000 (above half the rate of the sound device, it acts as half of it) |
| `RESONANCE` | Q | 0.05 to 40 |
| `GAIN` | dB | -60 to 60 |
| `DELAY` | seconds | 0 to 4 |
| `FEEDBACK` | | 0 to 0.99 |
| `DAMPING`, `SIZE`, `WIDTH` | | 0 to 1 |
| `PREDELAY` | seconds | 0 to 1 |
| `THRESHOLD` | dB | -96 to 0 |
| `RATIO` | | 1 to 100 |
| `ATTACK`, `RELEASE` | seconds | 0 to 5 |
| `CEILING` | dB | -60 to 0 |
| `DRIVE` | | 0 to 1 |
| `RATE` | Hz | 100 to 192000 |
| `BITS` | | 1 to 24 |

The limiter has no look-ahead: it turns a peak down on the sample it arrives, so a ceiling far below the sound distorts it. The distortion drives the sound into a curve that keeps full scale at full scale, so it also makes quiet sounds louder. A reverb hears every speaker and plays on the front pair.

## Effects on channels

A bus effect works on everything on the bus and rings on after its sounds stop; a channel effect works on one sound and stops with it. Occlusion is the usual case for one: each sound behind a wall gets its own low-pass, set from the program's own line-of-sight test. For a reverb that many sounds share, put the reverb on a bus with `MIX` 1 and [send](ChannelSend) the channels to it.

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
hall = CreateAudioBus()
verb = AddAudioEffect(hall, BB_EFFECT_REVERB)
AudioEffectParam verb, BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX, 1

ch   = EmitSound(engine, ship)
wall = AddChannelEffect(ch, BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS)
ChannelSend ch, hall, 0.3
```

What a channel goes through: its volume and pitch, then air absorption, then its own effects, then its pan. From there it goes to its bus and to every bus it sends to.
